info.title: Blog Engine draft integration
info.description: Contract version 1, canonical article schemaVersion 2. One isolated instance per brand. Relative server URL is the configured mount. Bearer credentials own only integration-created drafts/assets; no publication, account posting or private training access. Unknown mutation outcomes require readback before retry. Legacy /api/blog-import routes remain mapped for compatible CNERD clients.

manifest.description: Measured manifest: schemaVersion 1, articleId, voiceId, sourceFingerprint, visibility draft, audio checksum/bytes/duration, source-matching sections and monotonic measured word alignment. See docs/NARRATION-PRODUCER.md.

post.description: This unscoped alias is rejected with 403. Use the producer-token job-scoped /narration-jobs/{jobId}/import route.

integrationToken.description: Scoped instance token from private setup output; never embed in article/config public output.

producerToken.description: Separate scoped producer token: only source export and audio import for integration-owned drafts. Cannot create/update articles, publish or access training.

attrs.description: Image attrs: src, alt, decorative, width, height, title. Heading level 2–4; cnerdBlock attrs contains matching id and validated block.

Article.description: Canonical Content only, schemaVersion 2. Private training/trainingDoc and arbitrary HTML are rejected. Image descriptions describe inspected files; intentional decorative images set decorative true.

SocialPack.description: Saved social package. File URLs are authenticated. Connected account posting is unavailable; export preparation does not publish.

NarrationJob.description: Persisted producer handoff. Waiting state is not a generated recording. Job package contains the canonical spoken-source sections and fingerprint for measured local production.

manifest.description: Measured manifest schema cnerd-narration-v1: articleId, voiceId, sourceFingerprint, visibility draft, audioSha256, duration, settings.engine/model/alignment, exact source words with id/tokenId/text/start/end/score, and source-matching chapter boundaries. See docs/narration.md.
